commit_message: primus first seed: VS queue opening board — four umbrella epics (queue, registrar, devices, fleet-ops) + the four deferred lanes (fleet-ops-1py.2)

nodes.title: VS queue — the fleet's own work queue (umbrella)
nodes.description:
Umbrella epic for the VS queue subsystem: the Dolt server (database vs_ops, user vs) on the master device, the bd client fleet, and the Scotty read-only dashboard. This queue is the VS fleet's ONLY work queue; primus is the queue CURATOR (docs/queue-conventions.md).

UMBRELLA STAYS OPEN (Cabal mirror, fleet/conventions/beads-epic-structure): umbrella epics collect future work and are never closed on child completion — closing drops them off the dashboard Epics tab. Children carry the real acceptance criteria.

Standing contracts: joining is CONFIG-ONLY (.beads/metadata.json + .beads/dolt-server.port with the canonical project_id bcde5891-5482-4eb0-a223-8533504832d6 — the fleet contract, minted once by the coordinator's one-time init). NEVER run any bd init variant — a second init rewrites the shared DB's project_id and locks out every client (the 2026-09-09 fleet lockout class). bd pin 1.2.2 is absolute: bd 1.3+ auto-migrates the shared Dolt schema and locks out every 1.2.2 client. Bootstrap reference: scripts/vs-queue-bootstrap.md; conventions: docs/queue-conventions.md.

nodes.title: VS registrar + master composition (umbrella)
nodes.description:
Umbrella epic for the registrar fleet app and the master device's composition: the identity registrar (TypeScript/Fastify/Node/Postgres, releases registrar-v*), its Postgres, the VS LiteLLM gateway, the caddy TLS edge, the scotty dashboard, and primus's own runtime (Dockerfile.hermes — bd 1.2.2 baked full read-write, queue join + docs + boot hook; fleet-ops-b1r, rebuildable from this repo with zero manual steps).

UMBRELLA STAYS OPEN — children carry the real ACs; new registrar/composition work lands as a child here. Release discipline: tags-only (registrar-v* → final release), canary-by-pinning, fleet pinned never individual devices (docs/balena-architecture.md).

nodes.title: VS devices fleet (umbrella)
nodes.description:
Umbrella epic for the balena devices fleet app (releases devices-v*): the per-device agent runtime + registrant (clock gate → registrar fetch → 0600 bundle write → ready marker → resident rotation watcher; docs/balena-devices-runbook.md). Identity lives on the data partition; a reflash re-fetches and the device is itself again.

UMBRELLA STAYS OPEN — children carry the real ACs. Current state at seed time: devices-v1.0.1 deployed, canary cycle complete, devices are queue WORKERS (read-write bd, not scotty's bd-readonly posture) once the runtime swap lands.

nodes.title: VS fleet operations & security (umbrella)
nodes.description:
Umbrella epic for cross-cutting VS operations and security: the TLS flip on the master (caddy :443/:8443), canary-by-pinning policy, fleet health watch, secrets handling, and device provisioning/onboarding. Mirror of the Cabal fleet's infra class (area:infra under its fleet epic).

UMBRELLA STAYS OPEN — children carry the real ACs. Owner-exception classes apply fleet-wide: credential writes, secret handling, package installs, and mutations of primus's own config or SOUL are never agent self-service.

nodes.title: Dolt true-rotation: owner decision on the vs DOLT_PASSWORD (deferred, accepted-risk ruling class)
nodes.description:
ID: vs-dolt-true-rotation. OWNER DECISION, deferred per the accepted-risk ruling class (Cabal mirror: fleet-ops-y1b ruling pattern; state record: fleet/status/vector-sigma-queue).

FACTS: the vs DOLT_PASSWORD is the 2026-09-29T22:46Z-era value — the attempted 01:15Z rotation was REVERTED after an ALTER USER paste error; the dolt image's CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS cannot update an existing user. A TRUE rotation therefore needs an in-container ALTER USER (dolt sql) or a volume re-bootstrap, then re-setting BEADS_DOLT_PASSWORD/DOLT_PASSWORD in the same fleet scope and re-cycling every client (scotty, primus). Exposure class unchanged at ruling time: queue empty + LAN-only.

OWNER OPTIONS: (1) rotate properly (in-container ALTER USER or re-bootstrap + fleet-scope variable update + client re-cycles), or (2) record a fresh accepted-risk ruling with a date. No agent self-service — credential writes are the owner-exception class.

nodes.title: Clock-gate NTP probe diagnostics — accept or file probe-fix lane (owner call, timesyncd-vs-chronyd)
nodes.description:
ID: vs-ntp-clock-gate (mirror of Cabal bead fleet-ops-ddm, from the 4z9 kill-test log pass).

FACTS: the devices-fleet registrant logs `clock gate: NTP not synchronized after 600004ms, proceeding best-effort` — the clock gate waits 10 min for NTP convergence, times out, then proceeds BY DESIGN (fail-open best-effort; never brick the device; TLS is the natural guard). (a) The warn fires only on BOOT after a long power-off or at first flash — a device rebooting from a running state carries sync in the kernel and never hits the wait. (b) The probe is systemd-timesyncd's /run/systemd/timesync/synchronized flag (clock-gate.ts) — on balenaOS 8 the flag may stay absent even when time is correct (chronyd-vs-timesyncd divergence), which would make EVERY cold boot pay the 10-min wait.

OWNER CALL: (1) accept as-is (a cold-boot-only 10-min delay, invisible to operations since identity-present boots skip the fetch path anyway), or (2) accept the delay but file the diagnostics lane: read the device's timedatectl state from the registrant container's host shell — if `System clock synchronized: yes` shows while the flag file is absent, the probe reads the wrong mechanism and a probe fix rides the next devices-v* tag. No correctness risk today (the 4z9 restarts passed; the warn is informational).

nodes.title: Real-agent-runtime swap on the devices fleet (Dockerfile.agent-hermes pattern; owner green-light required)
nodes.description:
ID: vs-devices-runtime-swap. Replace the devices app's placeholder agent runtime (node:22-bookworm-slim + gate.sh, balena/devices/agent/Dockerfile) with the real Hermes runtime per balena/devices/Dockerfile.agent-hermes — the FORWARD-SHAPE b1r documented but did NOT build (the explicit 'do NOT build the devices runtime' clause). OWNER GREEN-LIGHT REQUIRED before execution; the clause stands until the owner lifts it.

THE SWAP (per the forward shape): switch the devices docker-compose.yml agent service from image/placeholder to `build: context: . dockerfile: Dockerfile.agent-hermes`; then the same additions the registrar's primus image carries: (1) bd 1.2.2 baked FULL READ-WRITE (tarball+sha256 VERBATIM pattern, uname -m arch case, legacy-builder-safe — devices are queue WORKERS: read-write, never scotty's bd-readonly posture); (2) a config-only queue-join at /opt/vs/queue-join/.beads; (3) the docs at /opt/vs/docs; (4) the vs-queue-join.sh boot hook as /etc/cont-init.d/03-vs-queue-join. The device join differs from primus's in exactly TWO fields: dolt_server_host = the master's LAN address (fleet variable, never baked) and dolt_server_port = 3326 (the LAN-published port). Devices NEVER bd init — config-only join with the canonical project_id.

nodes.title: Future device onboarding runbook — end-to-end procedure for adding a VS device
nodes.description:
ID: vs-device-onboarding-runbook. The end-to-end procedure for adding a device to the VS devices fleet — write the runbook when the next device actually joins; until then this lane holds the checklist.

CHECKLIST (from the source docs): (1) balenaCloud provisioning — account limit is 10 devices shared across all fleets (1 registrar + 4 devices = 5 fits; docs/balena-architecture.md); (2) registrar device row + identity bundle pre-creation via the admin console (docs/balena-devices-runbook.md); (3) devices-app deploy with pin policy — pin the FLEET, never individual devices; canary by pinning then track-fleet; (4) first boot: clock gate → identity check → registrar call → 0600 bundle write → ready marker → resident rotation watcher; (5) the config-only queue join: .beads/metadata.json with the canonical project_id + dolt_server_host <master-LAN-IP>, port 3326, .beads/dolt-server.port, BEADS_DOLT_PASSWORD from the owner, actor stamp = the AGENT name (scripts/vs-queue-bootstrap.md §Device/client join). NEVER bd init on the device.
